direction: Evolve `score_ruin_nodes` from a monotone worst-cost removal ranking into a stagnation-adaptive multiplicative-gated rank-power ruin priority: score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings_i|/scale_norm * (1 + w_load*(load_r/mean_load)) * (1 + w_depot*(d(depot,i)/max_depot_d)) * (1 + w_dem*demand_i/mean_dem) * (1 + w_rdist*(route_dist_r/mean_route_dist)), p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio)), where p decays with iter_frac for early intensification on long/high-load routes and rises with stagnation_ratio for late diversification (route-breaking ruin) so the search escapes local optima on clustered / eccentric-depot / tight-capacity instances without ever consuming more than the shared deadline (all state arrays read-only, deterministic tie-breaking, no RNG).

operations.mechanism: Archive shows two m32_curve solvers nearly tied (15.7435 vs 15.7584, gap_over_sbs 0.24%, win split 13/11) → the template is at a plateau where only a better ruin-priority signal (not skeleton changes) can move the mean. KB method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 establishes (a) first_feasible_ms ~2-3 ms leaves ample 500 ms LNS margin, (b) the multiplicative-gated rank-power family is the only arm-reported score class that beat the L3-ctrl worst-removal baseline (23.3186 vs 23.3474) on blind-120, and (c) stagnation-aware diversification is listed as the strong regime for this hook. Hence I direct inner EoH at the gate/exponent hyper-surface (w_load, w_depot, w_dem, w_rdist, p decay/rise) while keeping Regret-2 repair, intra_2opt perturbation and R2R acceptance fixed, so attribution stays on the single evolvable hook. No postprocess (mode=none) is used since prior evidence attributes gains to ruin ordering, and added postprocessing would confound the gate ablation and risk budget overrun.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: Targeting the archive's weakest regimes (capacity_level=tight, spatial=clustered, depot_style=eccentric, where vbs_rel_gap_pct is most negative at -23.6/-20.9/-21.4), a multiplicative-gated rank-power ruin score that jointly prioritizes customers on high-capacity-utilization long routes (hard to reinsert, hence the binding constraint under tight capacity) and, under stagnation, flips the exponent upward to break up routes far from an eccentric depot, will lower mean objective on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 versus the round-2 champion (15.7435) by >0.05%, while preserving feasible-first-return and the deadline invariant (fixing the 25 ms/near-deadline early-stop pitfall is not required at 500 ms). This refines method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3's reported rank-power-with-multiplicative-gates rule by making the gate weights and exponent explicitly capacity-utilization- and eccentricity-aware rather than uniformly normalized.
